note: Shared between shoephone (Rust daemon) and shoephone-app (Swift approver). Both derive the bound challenge independently; each repo has a test asserting its own implementation reproduces every vector here. Edit in the daemon repo and copy to the app; scripts/e2e.sh in the app fails if the two copies differ.

vectors.name: the daemon's own unit-test vector
vectors.bytes_to_sign:
shoephone-scope-v1
host=web01
principal=agent-admin:web01
key=ssh-ed25519 AAAA key
ends_at=1800003600
nonce=abc123

vectors.name: a different host
vectors.bytes_to_sign:
shoephone-scope-v1
host=db01
principal=agent-admin:db01
key=ssh-ed25519 AAAA key
ends_at=1800003600
nonce=abc123
